profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company, traded under the ticker DDOG with CIK 0001561550, headquartered in New York, NY, and also listed under the alias DATADOG INC - CLASS A. Its website describes it as a cloud monitoring service, presenting metrics from all of a customer's apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial offered.

The AI-related material on the site is framed around security. The company describes defending against AI-powered attacks and says that integrating security and observability lets organizations decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response with what it calls agentic speed. No individual products are listed for the company, and no MCP servers are recorded.

On the legal side, no lawsuits are listed. Its recorded law exposure is in New York, with a count of 458.
